{{Short description|Sporadic simple group}}
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Mathieu group M<sub>23</sub>}}
{{for|general background and history of the Mathieu sporadic groups|Mathieu group}}
{{Group theory sidebar |Finite}}

In the area of [[modern algebra]] known as [[group theory]], the '''Mathieu group''' ''M''<sub>23</sub> is a [[sporadic simple group]] of [[order (group theory)|order]]
:&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;10,200,960 = 2<sup>7</sup>{{·}}3<sup>2</sup>{{·}}5{{·}}7{{·}}11{{·}}23
: ≈ 1 × 10<sup>7</sup>.

==History and properties==
''M''<sub>23</sub> is one of the 26 sporadic groups and was introduced by {{harvs|txt |authorlink=Émile Léonard Mathieu |last=Mathieu |year1=1861 |year2=1873}}.  It is a 4-fold transitive [[permutation group]] on 23 objects.  The [[Schur multiplier]] and the [[outer automorphism group]] are both [[Trivial group|trivial]].

{{harvtxt|Milgram|2000}} calculated the integral cohomology, and showed in particular that M<sub>23</sub> has the unusual property that the first 4 integral homology groups all vanish.

In 2026, Xiaoyu Huang, Blake Jackson, Kyu-Hwan Lee, Bjorn Poonen, Rachel Pries, and Shaowu Zhang proved that M<sub>23</sub> occurs as a [[Galois group]] over the [[rational number]]s, completing the realization of all 26 sporadic simple groups. They constructed a regular Galois extension of {{math|'''Q'''(''t'')}} with Galois group M<sub>23</sub> and an explicit degree-23 [[polynomial]] with rational coefficients whose splitting field has Galois group M<sub>23</sub> over {{math|'''Q'''}}:<ref>{{cite arXiv |last1=Huang |first1=Xiaoyu |last2=Jackson |first2=Blake |last3=Lee |first3=Kyu-Hwan |last4=Poonen |first4=Bjorn |last5=Pries |first5=Rachel |last6=Zhang |first6=Shaowu |title=The Mathieu group M23 is a Galois group over Q |date=2026 |eprint=2608.08538 |class=math.NT}}</ref>

f(x) = x<sup>23</sup> – 184x<sup>21</sup> – 1150x<sup>20</sup> + 26151x<sup>19</sup> + 18400x<sup>18</sup> – 1808490x<sup>17</sup> + 1545462x<sup>16</sup> + 67672923x<sup>15</sup> – 42732528x<sup>14</sup> – 1333395744x<sup>13</sup> + 290615166x<sup>12</sup> + 10550424369x<sup>11</sup> + 3700476348x<sup>10</sup> + 35123826654x<sup>9</sup> – 194398310718x<sup>8</sup> – 1023887308293x<sup>7</sup> + 3961650395556x<sup>6</sup> + 1949980486716x<sup>5</sup> – 28142323927002x<sup>4</sup> + 53599151839311x<sup>3</sup> – 46185312415788x<sup>2</sup> + 19169943578802x – 3150159884154

Also in 2026, Spencer Bromberg and Alexander Bromberg presented a complementary positive-dimensional [[Hurwitz space|Hurwitz-space]] approach to the [[inverse Galois problem]] for M<sub>23</sub> over {{math|'''Q'''}}, beginning with the Nielsen class (2A, 2A, 3A, 5A). Their preprint reconstructs a 980-element pure-[[braid group|braid]] orbit and the associated genus-119 Hurwitz curve, passes to a degree-2,940, genus-43 reduced ''j''-line cover, and develops connected five- and higher-branch refinements relating this geometry to the Huang–Jackson–Lee–Poonen–Pries–Zhang realization.<ref>{{cite report
 |last1=Bromberg
 |first1=Spencer
 |last2=Bromberg
 |first2=Alexander
 |title=Galois Covers of M23 over Q: A Positive-Dimensional Approach
 |date=2026
 |publisher=Zenodo
 |type=Preprint
 |doi=10.5281/zenodo.22010546
 |url=https://zenodo.org/records/22010546
}}</ref>

===Construction using finite fields===

Let {{math|'''F'''<sub>2<sup>11</sup></sub>}} be the [[finite field]] with 2<sup>11</sup> elements.  Its [[group of units]] has order {{math|2<sup>11</sup>}} − 1 = 2047 = 23 · 89, so it has a [[cyclic group|cyclic]] [[subgroup]] {{math|C}} of order 23.

The Mathieu group M<sub>23</sub> can be identified with the group of {{math|'''F'''<sub>2</sub>}}-[[Linear map#Endomorphisms and automorphisms|linear automorphisms]] of {{math|'''F'''<sub>2<sup>11</sup></sub>}} that stabilize {{math|C}}.  More precisely, the [[group action|action]] of this [[automorphism group]] on {{math|C}} can be identified with the 4-fold transitive action of M<sub>23</sub> on 23 objects.

==Representations==

M<sub>23</sub> is the point stabilizer of the action of the [[Mathieu group M24]] on 24 points, giving it a 4-transitive [[permutation representation]] on 23 points with point stabilizer the [[Mathieu group M22]].

M<sub>23</sub> has 2 different [[rank 3 action]]s on 253 points. One is the action on unordered pairs with orbit sizes 1+42+210 and point stabilizer M<sub>21</sub>.2, and the other is the action on heptads with orbit sizes 1+112+140 and point stabilizer 2<sup>4</sup>.A<sub>7</sub>.

The integral representation corresponding to the permutation action on 23 points decomposes into  the trivial representation and a 22-dimensional representation. The 22-dimensional representation is irreducible over any [[field (mathematics)|field]] of [[characteristic (algebra)|characteristic]] not 2 or 23.

Over the field of order 2, it has two 11-dimensional representations, the restrictions of the corresponding representations of the [[Mathieu group M24]].
